title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is the closing page of a letter to Grothendieck signed 'Pierre', presumably Pierre Deligne, since it explains CM theory to him. It belongs to the 'Teichmülleries' correspondence, where Galois actions on moduli and special points were under discussion.

The previous page states the main theorem of complex multiplication (Shimura–Taniyama), in Deligne's adelic form.
- Take a CM abelian variety with extra structure (A, m, α), where α is an adelic level structure.
- For u in Gal(Q̄/K') (K' the reflex field), the isomorphism class of u(A, m, α) depends only on the image of u in the abelianization.
- It equals the class of (A, m, δ(ũ)^{-1}∘α), where ũ is an idèle attached to u by class field theory and δ is the reflex norm.
- The page then specializes to K imaginary quadratic. An elliptic curve with CM by O_K is the same as a CM curve up to isogeny together with an adelic trivialization V_{A^f}(A) ≅ A^f_K, taken modulo Ô^*.

This page draws the classical corollary.
- Gal(Q̄/K) permutes the isomorphism classes of elliptic curves with CM by O_K (with the action on Lie normalized by the fixed embedding).
- The action factors through Gal(H/K) ≅ Cl(K), where H is the Hilbert class field. This is because modulo Ô^* the idèle class group becomes K^*\A_K^{f*}/Ô^* = Cl(K).
- An element σ corresponding to an ideal class (σ) acts by σ(E) ≅ E ⊗_O (σ) or E ⊗_O (σ)^{-1}. The writer explicitly declines to fix the sign convention.

The purpose is to give Grothendieck a concrete picture of how Galois acts on CM points of moduli spaces.
errors: No mathematical error, but the sign is deliberately left open. With the standard (arithmetic) Artin symbol, σ_a acts by j(Λ) ↦ j(a^{-1}Λ). Since E ⊗_O a has lattice aΛ, one gets σ_a(E) ≅ E ⊗_O a^{-1} ≅ Hom_O(a, E). This is consistent with the δ(ũ)^{-1} on the previous page.

ideas.what: Gal(Q̄/K) acts on CM elliptic curves with CM by O_K through Cl(K), via σ_a(E) ≅ E ⊗_O a^{∓1}
ideas.modern_name: Main theorem of complex multiplication for elliptic curves; Hilbert class field H = K(j(E))
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kronecker, Weber, Hasse, Deuring; Shimura–Taniyama (1961) for the general form
ideas.where_published: Standard references: Shimura, Introduction to the Arithmetic Theory of Automorphic Functions; Silverman, Advanced Topics, Ch. II; Deligne's Corvallis/Milne expositions of the adelic form

ideas.what: Description of O-CM elliptic curves as isogeny classes plus adelic lattices/trivializations modulo Ô^*
ideas.modern_name: Adelic description of CM points of Shimura varieties
ideas.where_published: Deligne, 'Travaux de Shimura', Sém. Bourbaki 389 (1971); Milne's notes on CM

deep.surprise_reason: This is a textbook specialization of the main theorem of CM, written by Deligne (not Grothendieck) in a letter. Its only interest is historical: it documents Deligne explaining CM theory to Grothendieck during the Teichmüller/Galois-action period.
transcription_corrections: The marginal insertion 'd'iso de' belongs after 'ces classes', giving 'ces classes d'iso de courbes elliptiques'. The transcription renders this correctly.
The signature is 'Pierre' (likely Pierre Deligne), and the page is the end of a letter to Grothendieck, not Grothendieck's own notes.
The archive page number written on this page is 124.
